title: Can Hair Regrow Naturally in 3 Weeks? What the Research Shows

seo_description: No study shows hair regrowth in three weeks. See what research says about the hair cycle, seasonal shedding and how long nutritional shedding takes.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Merge target; old post 'Exploring The Options' suggested quick regrowth; no source supports a 3-week timeline, so the rewrite says so.
flags: COMPLIANCE: the old title implied hair can regrow naturally in 3 weeks; rewrite says no evidence.
